feed.title: [Freightos Weekly Update] Asia - Med rates back to pre-peak levels as Red Sea transits increase
feed.summary: This Freightos Weekly Update details the state of global shipping, noting that US-China trade talks are ongoing to maintain stability, with a potential extension of the trade truce. While transpacific container rates remain high due to demand and congestion, Asia-Europe spot rates are cooling, particularly for the Mediterranean, which has returned to pre-peak levels due to increased Red Sea transits. Air cargo rates from China to N. Europe have also fallen, reflecting a slowdown in e-commerce demand.

feed.summary: Kraft Heinz, in collaboration with Google and Kantar, is rethinking its approach to creator content, moving beyond mere views and comments to focus on brand effectiveness. feed.title: Zero fatalities, but more emissions per unit of copper: Ero Copper (ERO) reviews 2025.

feed.title: What Does NVIDIA Offer That Texas Instruments Does Not?
feed.summary: This article compares NVIDIA (NVDA) and Texas Instruments (TXN), both chip manufacturers, highlighting their differing business models and market positions. NVIDIA dominates the data center market, experiencing high demand and supply constraints, while TI serves industrial and automotive sectors in addition to data centers, with spare manufacturing capacity. The analysis shows NVIDIA leading in growth, profit margins, and low debt, but TI offers a lower price-to-sales ratio and a strong dividend history.

feed.title: Apple hit with another lawsuit over AirTag stalking after class action fails
feed.summary: Apple is facing a new lawsuit alleging its AirTag products facilitate stalking and unwanted tracking, filed by plaintiff Jane Doe M.R. 1 in Illinois federal court. This new legal action comes after a previous class action lawsuit against Apple regarding AirTag stalking failed to certify a class of victims, with a judge suggesting individual mass tort claims.

feed.title: SAU Foundation receives $50,000 gift from ExxonMobil for Workforce Development Center
feed.summary: ExxonMobil has donated $50,000 to the Southern Arkansas University (SAU) Foundation to support the construction of the SAU Workforce Development Center. feed.title: Blackstone Launches Multi-Asset Private Markets Fund

feed.title: McDonald’s provides new update on NEXT strategy
feed.summary: McDonald's has released new details on its NEXT strategy, which includes an $8.5 billion investment to support franchisees over the next decade, with $5 billion specifically allocated for rent relief and capital support through 2030. The strategy aims to expand market share in chicken and beverages, improve operating margins, simplify operations, modernize restaurants, and deploy GenAI-enabled ArchIQ. These initiatives are part of the broader "Make It Golden" campaign focused on enhancing customer experiences.

The company expects to complete the statewide rollout by the end of 2027, enhancing grid responsiveness and outage detection.
